cards.name: Ka-Zar of the Savage Land
cards.oracle_text:
You may look at the top card of your library any time.
You may play lands from the top of your library.
When Ka-Zar enters, create Zabu, a legendary 2/2 green Cat creature token with "Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Zabu."

cards.name: Icecave Crasher
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, this creature gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Tyvar's Stand
cards.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +X/+X and gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control. Damage and effects that say "destroy" don't destroy it.)

cards.name: Aggressive Instinct
cards.oracle_text: Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.

cards.name: Split the Spoils
cards.oracle_text: Exile up to five target permanent cards from your graveyard and separate them into two piles. An opponent chooses one of those piles. Put that pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard. (Piles can be empty.)

cards.name: Noxious Revival
cards.oracle_text:
({G/P} can be paid with either {G} or 2 life.)
Put target card from a graveyard on top of its owner's library.

cards.name: Sami's Curiosity
cards.oracle_text: You gain 2 life. Create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")

cards.name: Veil of Summer
cards.oracle_text: Draw a card if an opponent has cast a blue or black spell this turn. Spells you control can't be countered this turn. You and permanents you control gain hexproof from blue and from black until end of turn. (You and they can't be the targets of blue or black spells or abilities your opponents control.)

cards.name: Close Encounter
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, choose a creature you control or a warped creature card you own in exile.
Close Encounter deals damage equal to the power of the chosen creature or card to target creature.

cards.name: Bramble Armor
cards.oracle_text:
When this Equipment enters, attach it to target creature you control.
Equipped creature gets +2/+1.
Equip {4} ({4}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)

cards.name: Call of the Herd
cards.oracle_text:
Create a 3/3 green Elephant creature token.
Flashback {3}{G} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
